items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: Well, one -- it was two saxophone players, and one -- the alto player, now his name is Jimmy Jeter.

ctx.x: Well listen, tell me a little bit about that band. I've always heard of that band. But tell me about that band. I mean why is it called Jeter-Pillar's, and why --
Well, one -- it was two saxophone players, and one -- the alto player, now his name is Jimmy Jeter.
